sample_mapping_evidence: GEO original design identifies paired blood/tumor specimens from 26 HNSCC patients and six healthy blood donors. Select only 32 PBMC records, exclude paired tumors and tonsils. Preserve live CD45-positive selection. GSM is specimen key, original HNSCC/HD identifier is donor label. PBMCpedia P037_SRP226817 is overlapping reprocessing and must not be counted additionally.
